newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index rises in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index rises in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index rose 11.2 points or 0.40 percent last week. The All Ordinaries index fell 0.51 percent.
Sept 20 Sept 16 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
"Speculative situations remained volatile with falls outnumbering gains four to three," Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a weekly commentary.

AMX Resources NL jumped as high a 35 cents on speculation from drilling at its Paddington gold project north of Kalgoorlie but dropped back on the release of encouraging results to finish the week at 31.5 cents, up seven cents.
North Star Resources NL rose three cents to 14 cents following the placement of 12 million shares at 10 cents to Plutonic Resources Ltd.
Troy Resources NL, North Star's joint venture partner at the Three Rivers gold project near Peak Hill, Western Australia, also jumped, by 20 cents to 90 cents.

Carpenter Pacific Resources NL rose 4.5 cents to 13.5 cents as the company prepared to drill at Mt Kare, Papua New Guinea, in October. Mt Kare partner Ramsgate Resources NL firmed 1.5 cents to 9 cents.

Other improvers included Kurnalpi Gold NL, up 4.5 cents to 21.5 cents, Nugold Hill Mines NL, up 1.5 to 7.5 cents, Consolidated Gold NL, up 7 to 48 cents and Gawler Craton explorer Equinox Resources NL, up 6 6 to 34 cents.
Falls included Koongie Park joint venturers Lachlan Resources NL, which fell 3 to 26, and Anglo Australian Resources NL, down one to 10.5 cents.
Western Reefs Ltd gave back some of its recent gains to fall 10 cents to 63 cents while Border Gold Ltd slipped 1.5 cents to 16 cents as September options ceased trading, effectively worthless.
